Senior Product Engineer
Harbor Labs, Remote (US)

About the role
Harbor Labs builds planning software for architecture studios. Small team, high ownership, sharp design bar.

Requirements
At least 5 years of product engineering experience.
Deep experience building interfaces in React.
Strong TypeScript throughout the codebase.
Production experience with Next.js.

Nice to have
Schema design experience with GraphQL.

Responsibilities
Own planning canvas features from idea to ship.
Raise the bar on interaction quality.
Shape the frontend architecture as we grow.
